text: **Assessment complete.** I verified the discount engine's functional correctness: the tiered rate logic (5% below, 10% at/above 10,000), loyalty stacking (1% per year up to 5%), and rounding all work as documented. I identified two key design observations: the hardcoded reference date (`'2026-09-01'`) will cause incorrect calculations after that date, and the function lacks input validation for edge cases like negative amounts or future member dates. The assessment is written to ASSESSMENT.md without modifying any code.
